categories.desc: Gear, radios and vehicles behind policing. (Most police employers are governments, so there's no 'employer' stock here.)

categories.name: Cosmetology
categories.desc: Product makers, supply stores and salon chains.

categories.name: HVAC
categories.desc: Equipment makers, the distributor techs buy from, and a contractor that hires.

categories.name: Engineering / Manufacturing
categories.desc: Heavy equipment, automation, welding and industrial supply.

categories.name: Carpentry
categories.desc: Lumber, tools, home-improvement retail and building products.

AXON.what: Tasers, body cameras and Evidence.com digital-evidence software.
AXON.hook: Body cams went from rare to standard. How did that show up in Axon's revenue and stock?

MSI.what: Police and fire radios, 911 dispatch and command-center software.
MSI.hook: Who pays for the radio on every officer's belt, and how often does it get replaced?

FSS.what: Emergency light bars and sirens; also street sweepers and vacuum trucks.
FSS.hook: A smaller company that's on almost every cruiser. Do smaller stocks move more day to day?

SWBI.what: Handguns and rifles for law enforcement and civilian buyers.
SWBI.hook: Watch how this stock reacts to news headlines and elections.

PG.what: Pantene, Head & Shoulders, Olay and many household brands; a classic steady dividend stock.
PG.hook: Compare PG's daily moves to e.l.f.'s. Why is one so much calmer?

EL.what: MAC, Clinique, Aveda; Aveda also runs cosmetology schools.
EL.hook: Pull up EL's 5-year chart. What story does it tell?

SBH.what: Sally Beauty stores plus CosmoProf, the supplier for licensed professionals.
SBH.hook: Once you're licensed, where will you buy your supplies?

ULTA.what: Beauty retailer with in-store salons that hire licensed stylists.
ULTA.hook: Retail plus salon services: which part of the business matters more?

ELF.what: Low-price cosmetics popular with teens; a volatile, fast-moving stock.
ELF.hook: Can a social-media trend show up in a stock price?

CARR.what: Residential and commercial heating and cooling; Willis Carrier invented modern air conditioning.
CARR.hook: AC was invented in 1902. Is this company still growing?

TT.hook: Trane vs. Carrier: same industry, different charts?

LII.what: Residential furnaces, AC and heat pumps sold directly to contractors.
LII.hook: Does a hot summer or a cold winter show up in Lennox's results?

WSO.what: Largest HVAC/R equipment distributor in North America.
WSO.hook: Where does a tech actually pick up the unit before an install?

FIX.what: Mechanical and electrical contractor; data-center projects have driven big growth.
FIX.hook: Data centers need huge amounts of cooling. Who does the install work?

MSFT.what: Windows, Office, Azure cloud and widely used IT certifications.
MSFT.hook: Which Microsoft products did you use today?

CSCO.what: Networking hardware and the CCNA certification.
CSCO.hook: Most networks you've used run through Cisco gear. Is it a growth stock or a steady one?

NVDA.what: Graphics and AI chips used in data centers and gaming.
NVDA.hook: Look at NVDA's 5-year chart. What changed?

IBM.what: Hybrid cloud, AI and mainframes; IBM helped create the P-TECH school model.
IBM.hook: The company behind P-TECH: what does it actually sell today?

CRWD.what: Cybersecurity software protecting company computers and networks.
CRWD.hook: Look up July 2024. What did one bad software update do to the stock?

CAT.what: Heavy construction and mining equipment, engines and generators.
CAT.hook: CAT is often called an economic bellwether. Why?

ROK.hook: Ever programmed an Allen-Bradley PLC? That's Rockwell.

LECO.hook: What brand is the welder in your shop?

FAST.what: Industrial and construction supplies, including on-site vending machines at factories.
FAST.hook: How does a company that sells nuts and bolts become a big stock?

DE.what: Agricultural and construction machinery; a major U.S. manufacturing employer.
DE.hook: How might crop prices affect tractor sales?

GE.what: Jet engines for commercial and military aircraft.
GE.hook: GE used to make light bulbs and fridges. What happened?

HD.what: Largest home-improvement retailer, with a big pro-contractor business.
HD.hook: Does a housing slowdown show up in HD's chart?

LOW.hook: Head-to-head: HD vs. LOW over 1 year and 5 years.

WY.hook: Track lumber prices next to WY's stock. Do they move together?

TREX.what: Composite decking made from recycled materials.
TREX.hook: Decks are a summer project. Is there a seasonal pattern?

F.what: Trucks, cars and EVs; builds the Police Interceptor Utility.
F.hook: F-150 vs. EVs: where is Ford's money coming from?

TSLA.what: Electric vehicles, batteries and charging; EVs need different service skills.
TSLA.hook: Gas vs. EV: compare F and TSLA over 5 years.

SNA.what: The tool truck: hand tools, diagnostic scanners and tool financing.
SNA.hook: Snap-on also lends money to techs for tools. How does that affect the business?

ORLY.what: Auto-parts stores serving DIY customers and professional shops.
ORLY.hook: More older cars on the road means more repairs. Good for O'Reilly?

PPG.what: Paints and coatings, including automotive refinish paint for body shops.
PPG.hook: Body-shop paint is only part of PPG. What else do they make?

GM.hook: Ford vs. GM: which has done better lately?

ETN.what: Breakers, panels and power distribution; strong data-center demand.
ETN.hook: Whose name is on the breaker panel at your house?

HUBB.what: Wiring devices, connectors and utility equipment.
HUBB.hook: Look at the receptacles in this room. Who made them?

GWW.hook: Why do contractors buy from a distributor instead of the manufacturer?

PWR.what: Largest employer of utility lineworkers; power-grid construction.
PWR.hook: More data centers and EVs need more grid. Who builds it?

GNRC.what: Home standby generators, often installed by electricians.
GNRC.hook: Check GNRC's chart after a major hurricane or ice storm.
